name: vodoo
description: Odoo for Claude: projects and tasks, helpdesk, CRM, knowledge, documents, accounting, activities, and timers (Odoo 17-19).
long_description: Work with projects, tasks, milestones, helpdesk tickets, CRM leads and the pipeline, knowledge articles, and documents. Search and read any Odoo model, work with invoices, bills, journal entries, and payments, post chatter notes, handle attachments, and track time. Read-only by default: turn on write access in the settings. Leave the connection fields empty to use your existing Vodoo configuration (~/.config/vodoo).

odoo_url.title: Odoo URL
odoo_url.description: For example https://yourcompany.odoo.com. Leave empty to use your Vodoo configuration (~/.config/vodoo).

odoo_api_key.title: API key or password
odoo_api_key.description: Create an API key in Odoo: your avatar > My Profile > Account Security > New API Key. Stored in the system keychain.

instance.title: Vodoo profile
instance.description: Optional: name of a Vodoo instance profile to use instead of the fields above.

allow_write.title: Allow changes
allow_write.description: Let Claude create and change data: tasks, tickets, leads, articles, documents, invoices and bills, posting, payments, notes, attachments, activities, timers.

upload_dirs.title: Folders Claude may attach files from
upload_dirs.description: Default: Downloads, Desktop, and Documents. Hidden files and folders are always refused.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: The only folder attachments are downloaded to. Default: Downloads/vodoo.
